content.content: 1. License, applied once per prerequisite in depends_on: read the dependent clause by clause against each prerequisite; no clause may contradict either prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting clause — name the clause and the prerequisite it departs from.
content.rationale: The dependent is a requirement sentence, and both prerequisites carry prose, not artifacts: twpvqstu fixes the store's form, its handle-derived path and its discovery by scanning; ulqqklzk fixes the place and the untracked tracking boundary. Each edge therefore takes the natural-to-structured gate cell, whose check is licence — a requirement sentence is still words, so its gate is non-violation and not a demand for behavior. One evaluation covers both edges because they are two sides of one answer: the dependent's clauses about how a record is kept and how it is found lean on the form and the path from twpvqstu and on the untracked place from ulqqklzk at once, and a single licence pass reads the whole requirement against both, so splitting would check the same clauses twice. Nothing runs at this layer: a reviewer applies the criterion once per prerequisite to the recorded nodes and reports any contradicting clause as the finding. The criterion tracks no wording of the dependent, pre-names no element of either side, and states no rule the prerequisites do not.
